$description: Tier 2 · Semantic roles. Emitted as --* (no prefix). The canonical roles are named as in Figma's Unicron / Theme collection (surface-ground, text-body, primary-fill …): each reads a theme slot, the stone slot in light (`$value`) and the graphite slot in dark (`$extensions["unicron.modes"].dark`). The shadcn/ui contract and the sidebar contract stay, as aliases of those roles, so existing classes keep working. No role points at the legacy neutral ramp; success, warning and info keep their accent ramps. Apps add their own roles in an extension layer (see examples/app-extension.css), never here.

unicron.theme.$description: Extra entries for the Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block. Radius steps name the scale (Unicron 2.0): rounded-xs 4, rounded-sm and bare rounded 6 (controls), rounded-md 8, rounded-lg 12, rounded-xl and up 16, rounded-full round. Spacing names become sizing utilities (h-control, h-control-s, size-icon, min-h-touch-min).

surface-ground.$description: Figma surface/ground. The page: the chat and the main content. Also the label on an active Filter Chip, where ink and ground swap.

surface-sunken.$description: Figma surface/sunken. The window edge and the left sidebar, a step below the ground.

surface-raised.$description: Figma surface/raised. Cards, the right panel, the composer. On stone it equals the ground, set apart by a hairline.

surface-popover.$description: Figma surface/popover. Solid menus, popovers and dialogs, under shadow-popover or shadow-dialog.

surface-popover-frost.$description: Figma surface/popover-frost. Frosted glass, the default for menus, tooltips and the floating tab bar: under a backdrop blur of --g-elevation-blur.

surface-hover.$description: Figma surface/hover. A row or quiet control under the pointer: the body ink at 5%, over whatever is underneath.

surface-selected.$description: Figma surface/selected. A selected or pressed row, pill, chip or segment: the body ink at 8%. A selected row adds an inset colour bar (Sean, 2026-11-24), never an accent fill.

surface-scrim.$description: Figma surface/scrim. The full-screen dim behind sheets, dialogs and menus. The colour only: the layer's opacity is a tier 3 knob (--c-scrim-sheet, -dialog, -menu). Never opaque, never blurred.

line-rule.$description: Figma line/rule. Hairlines and 1px borders: the body ink at 8%. Carded lists use it edge to edge between rows.

line-strong.$description: Figma line/strong. A stronger hairline: inputs, scrollbar thumbs, the Settings location rule. The body ink at 14%.

line-field.$description: Figma line/field. A field's resting border: the body ink at 14%, as Figma draws it (Unicron 2.0; 1.1's 3:1 border is gone). Focus draws line-focus. Tailwind: border-line-field; `input` is its shadcn alias.

line-focus.$description: A focus border: a field's 2px inside border, and the focus edge of a button, a switch or a checkbox that draws one. The identity fill on stone; on graphite the identity text colour, because the fill is a mid-tone there and falls under 3:1 against the dark surfaces (Unicron 17). Held to 3:1 against surface-raised and the ground.

line-invalid.$description: An error border: an invalid field's 2px border, and the 2px inside edge of an invalid button, switch or checkbox. The critical fill on stone; on graphite the critical text colour, which clears 3:1 where the fill does not (Unicron 17). Held to 3:1 against surface-raised and the ground.

line-grid-dot.$description: Figma line/grid-dot. The dot grid and the sheet grabber: the body ink at 14%.

text-secondary.$description: Figma text/secondary. Secondary ink: support text.

text-label.$description: Figma text/label. Muted ink: labels, meta, icons at rest; 4.5:1 or more on every layer.

text-faint.$description: Figma text/faint. Disabled and placeholder ink.

primary-fill.$description: Figma primary/fill. The app's identity as a solid: the one primary action of a screen, the selected-row edge, the tab indicator, a switch that is on, a field's focus border, the app mark.

primary-mark.$description: The identity as a mark with no words: the selected-row edge, the tab indicator, a progress cell, a dot. Such a mark has only its lightness to show it, so it holds Lc 30 against the surfaces it sits on (WCAG 1.4.11). The identity fill on stone; on graphite the identity text colour, because a fill dark enough to hold a white label sits under Lc 30 against the dark surfaces (Unicron 19). A fill that holds a label stays primary-fill.

primary-on-fill.$description: Figma primary/on-fill. Text and icons on primary-fill. Solved to APCA Lc 75.

primary-text.$description: Figma primary/text. The identity as small text, or as an icon on primary-soft. Solved to APCA Lc 60 on the ground.

primary-soft.$description: Figma primary/soft. The quiet identity tint: a selected row, the current nav item, the active dock tab, a calendar event, an artifact tile. Selection is this fill plus a 2px primary-fill edge, never a solid.

primary-display.$description: Figma primary/display. The identity as large type, 36px and up. Solved to APCA Lc 45, so it stays closer to the identity hue than primary-text. Never under 36px.

secondary-live.$description: Figma secondary/live: the shared Working blue, the same in every app (Unicron 2.0; 1.1's per-app teal retired).

secondary-soft.$description: Figma secondary/soft. The live hue's soft wash: diff additions, live highlights.

small-label.$description: Label ink for text under 16px, where an app holds small text to APCA Lc 75 and 4.5:1 (Synapse's gate; Synapse 1): the label ink moved towards the secondary ink until it reads Lc 75 and 4.5:1 on the ground, surface-raised, primary-soft and critical-soft, in the default theme and in all four apps' themes (93% of the way on graphite, 99% on stone). Mixed towards secondary, never past it, so it stays under text-secondary on every surface; in the apps' themes the step is under 2 Lc, because their label and secondary inks were solved to the ground with no room. text-label (Lc 60) stays the ink for everything else.

small-primary.$description: The identity as text under 16px, held to APCA Lc 75 and 4.5:1 on the ground, surface-raised, primary-soft and critical-soft (Synapse 1): primary-text moved towards the body ink (45% on stone, 51% on graphite, solved over the default theme and the four apps' themes). primary-text (Lc 60) stays for larger text and icons.

small-critical.$description: Error text under 16px, held to APCA Lc 75 and 4.5:1 on the ground, surface-raised, primary-soft and critical-soft (Synapse 1): critical-text moved towards the body ink (48% on stone, 51% on graphite).

small-live.$description: Live text under 16px, held to APCA Lc 75 and 4.5:1 on the ground, surface-raised, primary-soft and critical-soft (Synapse 1): the live colour moved towards the body ink (51% on stone, 50% on graphite). Text only: fills, marks and edges keep secondary-live.

needs-you-fill.$description: Figma needs-you/fill. The yellow block that waits on the person, the same in every app and both grounds. Also the label on the dark needs-you button. At most one per screen.

needs-you-on-fill.$description: Figma needs-you/on-fill. Text on the yellow; also the fill of the solid needs-you button and the border of the outline one.

critical-fill.$description: Figma critical/fill. Error as a solid: the destructive button, an invalid field's 2px border, a critical banner's edge.

critical-text.$description: Figma critical/text. Error text and a critical banner's icon.

critical-soft.$description: Figma critical/soft. A critical banner's background.

status-done.$description: Figma status/done. Done: the check mark and its word. A status word never shows without its mark.

status-working.$description: Figma status/working. Working: the ring with a moving arc, and its word.

status-failed.$description: Figma status/failed. Failed: the cross and its word.

status-idle.$description: Figma status/idle. Idle or paused: the hollow ring and its word.

status-needs-you.$description: Needs you: the filled amber dot and its word (an alias of needs-you-fill, so the five marks read from one family of names).

info-fill.$description: Figma info/fill. Counts and unread dots: the deep notify blue (Sean, 2026-11-23). Count Badge Severity=Important.

qr-plate.$description: Figma qr/plate. Always light, so codes scan.

qr-module.$description: Figma qr/module. Always dark, so codes scan.

state-hover.$description: The hover wash on a neutral or transparent control or row: an alias of surface-hover (5%, Unicron 2.0).

state-pressed.$description: The pressed wash: an alias of surface-selected (8%, Unicron 2.0). A solid fill shows pressed as itself at 85%.

diff-added.$description: The wash behind an added line of a diff: a neutral wash of the ink in the ground, 8% on graphite and 3% on stone, where 8% took body text under Lc 90 (Unicron 28; 1.1), the same rule in every app (cross-app decisions §11: Synapse's primary-soft and critical-soft read as one colour, so an identity tint cannot mark added lines). Not in Figma. The + mark always shows: colour never carries the meaning alone.

diff-removed.$description: The wash behind a removed line of a diff. The − mark always shows.

swatch-01.$description: Swatch 01 of 12 (red, hue 25): a person's colour for a calendar, a note, a label. A 2px bar, edge or an 8px square; holds Lc 60 as text on surface-ground and surface-raised in every mode. Never a status, never a fill behind text.

label-red.$description: Figma label/red. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-orange.$description: Figma label/orange. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-amber.$description: Figma label/amber. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-green.$description: Figma label/green. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-teal.$description: Figma label/teal. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-sky.$description: Figma label/sky. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-blue.$description: Figma label/blue. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-indigo.$description: Figma label/indigo. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-purple.$description: Figma label/purple. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-pink.$description: Figma label/pink. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-brown.$description: Figma label/brown. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

label-gray.$description: Figma label/gray. A person's colour for a tag, calendar or folder; never a status.

background.$description: The page. An alias of surface-ground, kept for the shadcn contract.

foreground.$description: Main text. An alias of text-body, kept for the shadcn contract.

card.$description: A raised surface. An alias of surface-raised, kept for the shadcn contract.

popover.$description: The shadcn popover surface: an alias of surface-popover (Unicron 2.0).

primary.$description: The app's identity as a solid. An alias of primary-fill, kept for the shadcn contract. It was near-black before 1.0: it is now the app's colour, for the one primary action of a screen.

secondary.$description: The shadcn neutral fill (bg-secondary). An alias of surface-raised. Not Figma's secondary/live: that is secondary-live.

muted.$description: A quiet fill: a track, a key. An alias of surface-raised.

support-foreground.$description: Support text: the lines that explain, under a title or beside a value. An alias of text-secondary (APCA Lc 75).

muted-foreground.$description: Labels and meta: when, how many, captions, overlines, placeholders, inactive tabs, keys. An alias of text-label (APCA Lc 60).

muted-foreground-on-fill.$description: The same ink inside a fill. It was a shade stronger than muted-foreground on the old ramp; Figma has one label ink, so the two are now equal. Kept because fills re-point --muted-foreground at it (@unicron/ui's styles).

faint-foreground.$description: The faintest ink. An alias of text-faint; see its limits there.

accent.$description: The hover and highlight fill of an item in a list or a menu: an alias of surface-hover (Unicron 2.0).

destructive.$description: Destructive and error text. An alias of critical-text. The solid is critical-fill, the wash critical-soft.

warning.$description: Something is wrong: an alias of severity-concerning-fill (Unicron 2.0).

info.$description: For your information: an alias of info-fill (Unicron 2.0).

success.$description: Done, worked, complete: an alias of status-done (Unicron 2.0).

success-foreground.$description: Success as text and icons: an alias of status-done.

success-surface.$description: A quiet success wash: 10% (stone) or 14% (graphite) of the done colour in the ground.

attention.$description: Waiting on the person. An alias of needs-you-fill: the yellow, in both grounds. As a fill it holds needs-you-on-fill text; as a small mark on stone it barely differs from the ground in lightness (scripts/contrast.mjs lists it), so pair it with a shape.

attention-foreground.$description: Attention as text and icons, on a surface: label/amber on stone, where the amber fill would not read, and the fill itself on graphite.

attention-surface.$description: A quiet attention wash: 14% of the needs-you amber in the ground.

running-foreground.$description: Running as text and icons: an alias of status-working.

running-surface.$description: A quiet running wash behind a row or a callout: 6% of the live colour in the ground. It was 14% before 1.1, which took live text on it under Lc 60 in every mode (Unicron 27); 6% is the strongest wash that keeps it there.

border.$description: Separators and 1px borders. An alias of line-rule.

input.$description: A field's resting border. An alias of line-field, 3:1 or more against the field and the ground (Unicron 18; it was the line-rule hairline in 1.0). Focus and error borders are line-focus and line-invalid.

ring.$description: The focus ring: 2px in the accent, offset 2px (Unicron 2.0; it was the ink in 1.1).

radius.$description: The control corner, 6px (Figma radius/control). Bare `rounded` and `rounded-sm` draw it.

radius-xl.$description: 16px (Figma radius/xl): the composer and the message bubble.

radius-round.$description: Round (Figma radius/round): pills, chips, dots, avatars.

size-control.$description: 48px (Figma size/control): every floating control, the tab bar, the status strip, a text field's least height. Tailwind: h-control, size-control, min-h-control.

size-check.$description: A checkbox and a radio: 20px (Figma size/check).

size-track.$description: A progress track and a thin bar: 4px (Figma size/track).

size-touch-min.$description: 44px (Figma size/touch-min): the floor for a touch target. Tailwind: min-h-touch-min, size-touch-min.

shadow-popover.$description: Figma Unicron Elevation/popover: menus, popovers, tooltips, the floating tab bar.

shadow-dialog.$description: Figma Unicron Elevation/dialog: dialogs and the phone sheet.

stroke-rule.$description: 1px: rules and borders. A stroke never adds height: on a part that hugs its content it is an inset shadow, not a border.

stroke-emphasis.$description: 2px: focus and error borders, the selected-row edge, the tab indicator.

motion-fast.$description: Small state changes and quick entrances: a hover, a tooltip or a menu appearing, anything leaving. 120ms, the floor below which a change reads as a jump. Tailwind's default transition duration (`transition`, `transition-colors`) is mapped to it.

motion-base.$description: A small surface arriving: a dialog, a popover, a toast.

motion-press.$description: A control going down under a press. Release runs on motion-fast.

motion-state.$description: A surface changing state: a sheet or a panel opening, a selection moving.

motion-move.$description: Travel across the screen. The longest a default motion runs.

motion-tick.$description: One step of a countdown ring, run linear so it tracks the clock.

motion-ease-enter.$description: Things arriving: fast out, gentle settle. The same curve as motion-ease.

motion-ease-exit.$description: Things leaving: they gather speed and go. Pair it with a shorter duration than the entrance.

motion-ease-move.$description: Travel and resize: a selection moving, a panel changing height.

motion-ease-emphasis.$description: A slight overshoot for a rare moment, such as a success. Never on a control used many times a minute.

motion-ease-pulse.$description: The curve of a pulse loop.

motion-spring-settle.$description: A thumb or a pill arriving at a new place. Use as a timing function with motion-spring-settle-duration.

motion-spring-firm.$description: A sheet or another large surface arriving, with no visible bounce. Use with motion-spring-firm-duration.

motion-stagger.$description: The delay between siblings that enter in turn.

motion-stagger-max.$description: Siblings after this many start together.

motion-press-depth-small.$description: Scale of a pressed icon-size control.

motion-spin.$description: One turn of a spinner or a working ring, so live states turn at one rate in every app. Tailwind's animate-spin runs on it.

motion-pulse.$description: One beat of a pulse or a breathing halo (needs-you, thinking). Tailwind's animate-pulse runs on it.

motion-ease.$description: The one curve: fast out, gentle settle. Tailwind's default transition curve and `ease-standard` are mapped to it.

sidebar.$description: The sidebar sits on the sunken layer, a step below the page (Unicron 2.0).

sidebar-accent.$description: The current item of the sidebar: the 8% selection fill (Unicron 2.0), with an inset bar where the row draws one.
